title: On the stationary measures of the critical Ornstein--Uhlenbeck process
summary: We study linear and symmetric diffusion processes on $\mathbb{R}^{\mathbb{Z}^d}$ that can be seen as the Langevin dynamics of the (inhomogeneous) harmonic crystal for given conductances, with a particular focus on their stationary distributions. Despite the linearity of the interaction, we exhibit a rich variety of behaviours, depending on the disorder encoded by the conductances. Our main results provide essentially sharp criteria on the conductances ensuring that every stationary measure is reversible.
